summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Maintenance bay. A coolant-balancing unit is open in the wall. A red status strip is visible. Middle image: Astra enters with coffee and three unrelated forms. Closing image: Procurement display shows the replacement-part delay.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Maintenance bay. A coolant-balancing unit is open in the wall. A red status strip is visible.
PANEL 2 — Zib studies a cracked stabilizer bracket.
PANEL 3 — Astra enters with coffee and three unrelated forms.
PANEL 4 — Zib points into the housing.
PANEL 5 — Procurement display shows the replacement-part delay.

dialogueInline.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogueInline.text: TEMPORARY FLOW INSTABILITY — NON-CATASTROPHIC BUT ANNOYING.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Tell me this is normal annoying.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Astra reads the ETA twice. Middle image: Jax arrives with a handheld flow reader. Closing image: Pixa projects a temporary-material-usage form.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra reads the ETA twice.
PANEL 2 — Medium on Zib continuing the hands-on task at the handheld reader, attention still on the job while the conversation continues nearby.
PANEL 3 — Close on Astra still working at the handheld reader; they answer or react without lifting their eyes from the task.
PANEL 4 — Jax arrives with a handheld flow reader.
PANEL 5 — Astra points at the unit. Jax looks at the reader, then the unit, and accepts that this is now his morning.
PANEL 6 — Pixa projects a temporary-material-usage form.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We are not doing procurement fraud before lunch.

dialogueInline.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogueInline.text: TEMPORARY MATERIAL USAGE REQUEST — JUSTIFY DEVIATION FROM IDEAL REALITY.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Mira works at a nearby lab bench with sealed samples retained from prior incidents. Labels are physical and cautious. Middle image: Mira stops. Closing image: Mira looks at the fragment, genuinely uncertain.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira works at a nearby lab bench with sealed samples retained from prior incidents. Labels are physical and cautious.
PANEL 2 — She presses a brittle fragment with a probe. It crumbles.
PANEL 3 — She taps a denser fragment against a steel test block. It clicks instead of flaking.
PANEL 4 — Tight reaction on Mira; their hands stop over the active work surface as they notice the change.
PANEL 5 — Zib glances over from the wall.
PANEL 6 — Mira looks at the fragment, genuinely uncertain.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Mira repeats the same simple compression test on both samples. Middle image: Mira holds up the two samples. Closing image: Mira raises one hand before anyone reacts, cautious expression fixed on the test result.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira repeats the same simple compression test on both samples.
PANEL 2 — She records the result.
PANEL 3 — Zib stares at her.
PANEL 4 — Mira holds up the two samples.
PANEL 5 — Close reaction on Astra beside the sealed sample and test bench; a small confirming nod toward Mira.
PANEL 6 — Mira raises one hand before anyone reacts, cautious expression fixed on the test result.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Same residue class. Different post-formation cohesion.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Glorp reviews the temporary repair authorization with visible alarm. Middle image: Zib speaks from inside the wall compartment. Closing image: Jax raises the flow reader. Astra nods once. No ceremony.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp reviews the temporary repair authorization with visible alarm.
PANEL 2 — Glorp taps the word TEMPORARY.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb reads beside them.
PANEL 4 — Zib speaks from inside the wall compartment.
PANEL 5 — Glorp deletes lines from the form until only three labeled fields remain.
PANEL 6 — Jax raises the flow reader. Astra nods once. No ceremony.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Temporary systems become permanent through exhaustion.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Mira and Zib build a small off-line test rig. Nothing touches station infrastructure yet. Middle image: Mira does not look up. Closing image: Zib points at the damaged sample.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira and Zib build a small off-line test rig. Nothing touches station infrastructure yet.
PANEL 2 — Mira lays out three test cards beside the rig: HEAT / COMPRESSION / VIBRATION.
PANEL 3 — Zib watches her deliberately abuse the sample.
PANEL 4 — Close on Mira still working at the sealed sample and test bench; they answer or react without lifting their eyes from the task.
PANEL 5 — The fragment survives heat and compression, then chips under sustained vibration.
PANEL 6 — Zib points at the damaged sample.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Heat first. Compression second. Then vibration.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: You say that like you want it to fail.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: I want it to fail here.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: So it is not a bracket.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Zib builds a conventional temporary brace from approved clamp hardware and mesh. The residue fragment is used only as gap-filling material inside the brace. Middle image: Zib tightens the approved clamp. Closing image: The unit restarts. Status changes on the display.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib builds a conventional temporary brace from approved clamp hardware and mesh. The residue fragment is used only as gap-filling material inside the brace.
PANEL 2 — Astra watches closely.
PANEL 3 — Zib tightens the approved clamp.
PANEL 4 — Mira checks the configuration.
PANEL 5 — The unit restarts. Status changes on the display.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Say exactly what it is doing.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Filling a gap. Clamp carries the load.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Jax watches the handheld reader beside the unit. Middle image: Jax shows her the handwritten schedule. Closing image: Zib isolates the unit immediately.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax watches the handheld reader beside the unit.
PANEL 2 — He logs the first interval.
PANEL 3 — Astra checks the temporary tag.
PANEL 4 — Jax shows her the handwritten schedule.
PANEL 5 — At the next reading, Jax notices a slight shift before anyone else does.
PANEL 6 — Zib isolates the unit immediately.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I know. That is why I wrote ten.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I was hoping you would say "nothing."

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Zib opens the brace again. Middle image: Jax holds the reader ready while Astra keeps the temporary authorization visible at the workbench. Closing image: Pixa's display shows measured flow and patch status only, without an explanatory headline.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib opens the brace again.
PANEL 2 — He adds more approved mesh and reduces the amount of residue filler.
PANEL 3 — Close reaction on Mira beside the temporary brace; a small confirming nod toward Astra.
PANEL 4 — Jax holds the reader ready while Astra keeps the temporary authorization visible at the workbench.
PANEL 5 — Zib restarts the unit.
PANEL 6 — Pixa's display shows measured flow and patch status only, without an explanatory headline.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: That is also my preferred ratio.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Flow variance reduced by eighteen percent.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: The unit completes another cycle. Middle image: Mira smiles despite herself. Closing image: Brick, already present, writes in his notebook.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The unit completes another cycle.
PANEL 2 — Mira checks the patch.
PANEL 3 — Zib studies the patch skeptically, one hand still on the approved clamp.
PANEL 4 — Mira smiles despite herself.
PANEL 5 — Across the bay, Astra turns toward them at the phrase.
PANEL 6 — Brick, already present, writes in his notebook.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: The clamp survived. The filler did not get in the way.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Nobody says "commercial" until I am dead.

dialogueInline.speaker: TEXT
dialogueInline.text: THE WEIRD THING GOT A JOB.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Mira builds a small results board: heat exposure, compression, vibration damage, installed configuration. Middle image: Mira points toward the temporary repair form. Closing image: Astra closes her eyes.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira builds a small results board: heat exposure, compression, vibration damage, installed configuration.
PANEL 2 — She looks at Astra.
PANEL 3 — Close on Astra beside the report screen; her shoulders loosen slightly as she reads the result.
PANEL 4 — Mira points toward the temporary repair form.
PANEL 5 — Mira turns the screen toward Astra and highlights the REPORT REQUIRED field.
PANEL 6 — Astra closes her eyes.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: You will hate the next part.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Safety record requires the material event.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Glorp traces the temporary-deviation reporting path on a tablet. Middle image: Astra points at the report destination. Closing image: Zib shuts the wall panel.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp traces the temporary-deviation reporting path on a tablet.
PANEL 2 — Close on Glorp lifting their gaze from the report screen toward Astra.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb meets Glorp's eyes over the tablet, antennae still and posture relaxed.
PANEL 4 — Astra points at the report destination.
PANEL 5 — Glorp shakes their head.
PANEL 6 — Zib shuts the wall panel.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: If it touched a system, it has a history.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Nobody made the reporting tree. It grew.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Astra and Mira face each other across the workbench with controlled, serious expressions; the report and patched unit sit between them. Middle image: Astra answers just as quietly. Closing image: Mira meets her gaze.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Mira face each other across the workbench with controlled, serious expressions; the report and patched unit sit between them.
PANEL 2 — Mira keeps her voice level.
PANEL 3 — Astra answers just as quietly.
PANEL 4 — Astra points to the single patched unit.
PANEL 5 — Mira meets her gaze.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: If this matters, we should report it correctly.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: If this matters, we should survive reporting it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: And turning one patch into a discovery is not science.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Mira studies Astra instead of the sample. Middle image: Astra turns from the report to scan the active maintenance bay: open unit, workbench and crew still working. Closing image: Astra nods.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira studies Astra instead of the sample.
PANEL 2 — Astra gestures toward the report.
PANEL 3 — Medium on Astra continuing the conversation beside the sealed sample and test bench, one hand still indicating the same document or equipment.
PANEL 4 — Astra turns from the report to scan the active maintenance bay: open unit, workbench and crew still working.
PANEL 5 — Mira meets Astra's eyes across the workbench, calm and firm.
PANEL 6 — Close reaction on Astra beside the report screen; a small confirming nod toward Mira.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: A useful anomaly gets a category.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: A category gets a target. A target gets a budget.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Then the budget tells us how to make more of it.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Zib, still trying to finish the actual repair, interrupts them. Middle image: He gives Mira the sensor lead. The three of them resume work. Closing image: Astra holds the brace steady.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib, still trying to finish the actual repair, interrupts them.
PANEL 2 — Medium close on Astra turning from the temporary brace toward Mira.
PANEL 3 — Zib hands Astra part of the brace.
PANEL 4 — He gives Mira the sensor lead. The three of them resume work.
PANEL 5 — Mira keeps talking while checking the sensor.
PANEL 6 — Astra holds the brace steady.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Then make it while holding this.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: I can write only what the test supports.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Glorp, Kreeb, Mira and Astra cluster around one terminal while the active maintenance bay remains visible behind them. Middle image: Kreeb nods. Closing image: Mira looks toward the patched unit.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp, Kreeb, Mira and Astra cluster around one terminal while the active maintenance bay remains visible behind them.
PANEL 2 — The report shows the narrow temporary-use finding and its limits.
PANEL 3 — Glorp studies it.
PANEL 4 — Close reaction on Kreeb beside the temporary patch; a small confirming nod toward Astra.
PANEL 5 — Astra rereads the screen.
PANEL 6 — Mira looks toward the patched unit.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: Incidental residue contributed to temporary gap filling under monitored conditions. Structural load remained on approved clamp. Repeatability unknown.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Jax arrives with the completed monitoring log. Middle image: Jax shrugs. Closing image: Astra signs.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax arrives with the completed monitoring log.
PANEL 2 — He hands it to Astra.
PANEL 3 — Astra checks the intervals.
PANEL 4 — Medium close on Jax beside the terminal; one small shrug, posture otherwise relaxed.
PANEL 5 — The terminal shows a blank STATION MANAGER SIGNATURE field above the SEND control.
PANEL 6 — Astra signs.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Four cycles. Still inside temporary limits.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: It kept asking for numbers, so I gave it numbers.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: There is only a narrow version.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: The maintenance bay is quiet. Jax remains beside the reader for the next scheduled interval. Middle image: Zib looks at him, mildly surprised. Closing image: The gauge stays within the temporary band.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The maintenance bay is quiet. Jax remains beside the reader for the next scheduled interval.
PANEL 2 — Zib walks through the quiet maintenance bay behind Jax, glancing toward the reader.
PANEL 3 — Jax checks the clock.
PANEL 4 — Zib looks at him, mildly surprised.
PANEL 5 — Close on Jax still working at the active work surface; they answer or react without lifting their eyes from the task.
PANEL 6 — The gauge stays within the temporary band.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I know. The next reading is in six minutes.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Astra and Mira perform the final read together. Middle image: Astra traces one sentence on the report with a fingertip, pausing over the highlighted causal wording. Closing image: Astra hits SEND herself.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Mira perform the final read together.
PANEL 2 — Astra points at a modifier.
PANEL 3 — Mira edits it.
PANEL 4 — Astra traces one sentence on the report with a fingertip, pausing over the highlighted causal wording.
PANEL 5 — Mira does not touch the screen.
PANEL 6 — Astra hits SEND herself.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: A notification arrives almost immediately. Middle image: Astra's face tightens as she reads the second line on the screen. Closing image: Brick closes his notebook.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A notification arrives almost immediately.
PANEL 2 — Astra exhales.
PANEL 3 — Insert on the active screen as a second line appears beneath the first notification.
PANEL 4 — Astra's face tightens as she reads the second line on the screen.
PANEL 5 — Mira reads it.
PANEL 6 — Brick closes his notebook.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Next cycle. The repaired unit hums. The temporary tag is still prominent. Middle image: Zib closes the panel. Closing image: Pixa's screen lights. Nobody speaks.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Next cycle. The repaired unit hums. The temporary tag is still prominent.
PANEL 2 — Zib checks procurement.
PANEL 3 — Astra points at the patch.
PANEL 4 — Zib closes the panel.
PANEL 5 — Mira seals another physical sample.
PANEL 6 — Pixa's screen lights. Nobody speaks.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Everything is temporary if procurement is involved.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Astra's terminal expands the notification. Middle image: Astra stares at the wording. Closing image: Astra looks through the glass toward the functioning maintenance bay.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra's terminal expands the notification.
PANEL 2 — A smaller line appears beneath it.
PANEL 3 — Astra stares at the wording.
PANEL 4 — Mira remains beside her.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks through the glass toward the functioning maintenance bay.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: THANK YOU FOR YOUR CONTRIBUTION TO STATION VALUE IDENTIFICATION.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: I still think we had to report it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: I just wanted one more day before it got a department.
